name: Rat Rig, Lda
summary: Faro, Portugal company best known for the open-source V-Core CoreXY printer kits, which extended into filament with the PunkFil line built on recycled feedstock, plus Ultembase PEI build plates. PunkFil's extruder is not disclosed; Rat Rig also resells third-party filament including eSUN and Sakata.

oem_relationships.notes: PunkFil is Rat Rig's own brand but Rat Rig has no known extrusion capability and names no manufacturer. Contract extrusion is the strong inference; the counterparty is unidentified.
Rat Rig resells eSUN PLA through its own store alongside PunkFil. A retail relationship, not white-labelling.

product_lines.name: PunkFil PETG-CF10 (recycled)
product_lines.notes: PETG + 10% carbon fibre, recycled feedstock - e.g. the 'Brute Black' SKU.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly EUR 27-51/kg. Rat Rig also resells Sakata 3D filament, which has no entry in this catalog, so that relationship is recorded here in notes rather than as an OEM edge. manufacturing_countries is empty: Portugal is where Rat Rig designs and assembles printers, not where PunkFil is extruded, and no extrusion country is disclosed. Ultembase PEI plates are sold alongside; no specific plate id is claimed, so plate_ids is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: PunkFil's manufacturer and country of origin are undisclosed; the recycled-feedstock claim is the brand's own and is not third-party certified in any source found.
